note.question: What determines assembly coordination and progress feedback?

components.label: Nash equilibrium and unique secure equilibrium without feedback
components.explanation: The model's equilibrium concept is Nash equilibrium and unique secure equilibrium without feedback; subgame-perfect secure equilibrium (SPSE) with feedback. The static game has a continuum of symmetric Nash equilibria but a unique secure selection; the dynamic model characterizes SPSE as feedback rounds change.
